version.author: Bianca
version.changelog: - **Latency > Count every format at its highest latency** (off by default). A plugin installed in several formats (AU, VST3, VST...) counts with the highest latency any of its formats reports: some formats, often AU, report 0 where another reports the real figure. Alerts, limits, the rack latency box, the FX menus and Show mode's offline step use it; REAPER's own compensation is not changed. The Plugin list marks estimated figures with * (hover for where they come from). Formats are matched on name and developer, ignoring the type, spaces, a channel count like "(4ch)" and the developer's name inside the plugin's name. - **Take FX over the limit offline in Show mode** now also acts while already in Show mode: turning on Count every format..., changing a latency limit, or turning this option on checks the racks again. The FX it adds come back online with the others when you go back to Edit. - The latency alert tag on the first row of racks is no longer cut off at the top. - The flashing red frame of a rack over its latency limit covers the rack's own frame completely (thicker, same corners), so the rack's color no longer shows through. - One gap everywhere: between racks (sideways and down) it is now the same as between the top bar and the first row (the room the latency tag needs plus the setting, 8 px by default: about 17 px instead of 8). The setting is now called **Extra space between racks**. - **Allow latency** stays per format. With the option on, allowing an FX that has other formats installed first says that only this format is allowed (that note can be hidden). - **"Don't show this again"** on popups that are not critical: creating a rack by double-click, replacing or deleting one FX, an action on several selected racks, and the scan notes. Once hidden, a question is answered yes without asking. On "new effects were found, scan now?" the checkbox turns off **Latency > Ask to scan new FX**. Popups that delete a rack or a sidechain bus, reset the settings or start a latency scan always show. - **Settings > Reset warning popups** shows every hidden popup again.
